title: Human-facing run output leads with the tick's try, not the run's dispatch counter
description:
OPERATOR, 2026-09-22: 'we gotta change the language on this one to make it less confusing for human log inspectors'.

What an operator saw, and read the natural way:

    w9b#5   dispatched: attempt 5 started as run-epic-wne/tick-w9b/attempt-5
            (w9b try 3; attempt numbers count this run's dispatches)

They took it as w9b's fifth try and asked why it needed so many. It was the third. The
'attempt' number is a RUN-WIDE dispatch counter (0ju got 1, mrn 2, w9b 3, 4, 5), and the
per-tick number a person actually wants sits in brackets after it, with a footnote
explaining the first number. The disclaimer is itself the evidence: a message that has
to explain its own headline number has the numbers the wrong way round.

Emitted from internal/reconcile/dispatch.go:618; the same run-wide number also heads the
'<tick>#<n>' prefix in ticfac watch, and appears in branch names
(ticfac/run-<id>/tick-<t>/attempt-<n>), worktree paths and the event feed's 'attempt'
field.

THE CHANGE: in everything written for a PERSON - event detail text, ticfac watch and
ticfac status lines - lead with the tick's own try and name the run counter for what it
is, e.g.

    w9b try 3   dispatched (run dispatch #5, branch …/tick-w9b/attempt-5)

and the '<tick>#<n>' watch prefix shows the try.

WHAT DOES NOT CHANGE IN THIS TICK: the run-wide number stays the attempt's IDENTITY.
Adoption by identity, the WIP snapshot refs, branch names and the event feed's
'attempt' field all key on it, and renaming a durable identifier across live runs is a
different and riskier change than relabelling text. If the feed should also carry the
per-tick try as its own field, add it alongside rather than repurposing 'attempt' -
contracts/run-event-feed.json requires 'attempt' on every line.

Sweep for the same inversion elsewhere while here: any line that says 'attempt N of
<tick>' where N is the run counter ('attempt 4 of w9b is still running', 'attempt 3 of
keh is missing-result') reads as 'the fourth attempt at w9b' and has the same problem.
acceptance_criteria: Every human-facing line that names an attempt leads with the tick's own try number and labels the run-wide counter as a dispatch number; the ticfac watch '<tick>#<n>' prefix shows the try; no line needs a parenthetical explaining what its headline number counts; branch names, WIP refs, adoption identity and the feed's 'attempt' field are unchanged; any new per-tick field in the feed is additive and the contract says so; and go test -short ./... passes
